r6-fowler.title: Refactoring pass (Fowler code smells)
r6-fowler.imperative: Run the refactoring / code-smell pass (SKILL.md 'Refactoring pass'). Render a verdict on each Fowler baseline smell (long method, large class, duplicated code, feature envy, data clumps, primitive obsession, long parameter list, shotgun surgery, divergent change, message chains, speculative generality, comments-as-deodorant): flagged / overridden / absent. Smells are judgment calls, ALWAYS subordinate to the repo's documented standards -- an override needs a logged standard + reason. Record the pass to templates/FOWLER_PASS.template.json, run scripts/verify_fowler_pass.py <record> (it refuses a skipped smell or an unlogged override), then record pass/fail with a finding. Do NOT silently skip this item.
constraints: Fowler smells are subordinate to documented repo standards; never hard violations
an override (smell not flagged because a standard wins) needs a logged reason
r6-fowler.finding: Ran the Fowler baseline pass over the diff and both new files, recorded to .agent-work/issue-422-wire-invariants/g1-review/fowler-pass.json, verified by scripts/verify_fowler_pass.py (exit 0: 'fowler pass ok ... smells=12, flagged=[], overridden=[primitive-obsession]'). 11 smells absent. One overridden: primitive-obsession (WORKTREE_ENTERING_GATES is a plain (str,str) tuple, not a NamedTuple/dataclass) -- subordinated to references/global-crew.md's 'minimal change, no speculative abstraction' doctrine, since wrapping a single-entry maintained list in a bespoke type ahead of a real second case would itself be the speculative-generality smell. No blocking code-smell findings.

r4b-fixture-isolation.title: Constraint: deliberate-breakage stays in temp/scratch fixtures
r4b-fixture-isolation.imperative: Confirm both deliberate-breakage tests run only against tmp_path/TemporaryDirectory or a fully-restoring stash/pop, never leaving the shared checkout/worktree broken; confirm post-run git status --porcelain shows only the three intended changed/new files. Record pass/fail with a finding.
r4b-fixture-isolation.finding: Read both test classes: EnumerationDeliberateBreakage writes its broken copy only under tempfile.TemporaryDirectory (setUp/tearDown), never mutating the real template on disk. EngineDeliberateBreakage builds a throwaway git repo (git init + one empty commit) inside a separate TemporaryDirectory, never touching this worktree's own .git. I additionally exercised the OTHER sanctioned construction myself (stash/pop of the real tracked file) as part of r1-handoff's independent reproduction and confirmed the restore was exact. Post-test-run git status --porcelain shows only the three intended changed/new files (COMMANDER_SPINE.template.json modified, the two new scripts/tests untracked) plus the untracked .agent-work/ work area -- nothing else dirty or missing.

r4c-crew-context-guard-rules.title: CREW_CONTEXT Verification Discipline rules
r4c-crew-context-guard-rules.imperative: Check against CREW_CONTEXT.md 'Verification Discipline': (a) checks assert behaviour not description text, (b) any guard that loops asserts what it looped over (prints/asserts the count), (c) guard-by-hand-maintained-list rule and whether the WORKTREE_ENTERING_GATES tuple is a justified exception. Record pass/fail with a finding.
r4c-crew-context-guard-rules.finding: (a) Behaviour-not-text: _condition_wires_isolation() matches check.kind=='command' and ISOLATION_SCRIPT_MARKER in the actual command string plus satisfied is False -- it asserts the runnable command, not a description/statement field. (b) Loop-asserts-count: verify_coverage() returns len(WORKTREE_ENTERING_GATES) and main() prints '{count} worktree-entering template(s) checked' -- confirmed count=1 in my own re-run, not a bare OK. (c) Hand-maintained-list rule: WORKTREE_ENTERING_GATES is a hand-maintained tuple, which CREW_CONTEXT.md generally discourages ('define a guard by its consumer's behaviour, not a hand-maintained list') -- but this is a documented, justified exception: the module docstring explains the membership fact (which roles get dispatched into an isolated worktree) is an architectural/deployment fact not recoverable by scanning template JSON content, and the handoff's own Map Anchors name this as decision:worktree-entering-membership, 'explicit maintained list, not a heuristic', graded guess with a settle: experiment (routed to triage as tc1 under r5-reconciliation). Judgment: acceptable, not a defect -- the general CREW_CONTEXT rule targets guards that COULD be computed from the code but were manually listed instead; here the ground truth is genuinely external.
